items.quote: These Procedures outline the process the University will follow when a member of the University community chooses to disclose or report an incident(s) of sexual or gender based violence or misconduct
items.reason: The policy has its own dedicated procedures that govern reports.

items.quote: The Sexual and Gender-Based Violence Advisory will support the creation of a Sexual and Gender-based Violence Prevention Webpage that will provide information about the Policy as well as support and response options and an up to date list of events, campaigns, and training opportunities.
items.reason: The policy mentions creating a webpage to provide information about the policy, but does not explicitly commit to posting the full policy text online.

items.quote: Reports can be made to, Threat Assessment Team directly or via the Co-Ordinator of the Threat Assessment Team.
items.reason: The policy specifies that reports can be made to the Threat Assessment Team or its coordinator, but does not provide specific contact methods.
The policy does not address the complainant's past sexual history.

items.quote: Complainants and Respondents will not have to engage or communicate with each other directly during a report and investigation process. This includes not being in the same space as part of the process.
items.reason: The policy guarantees that complainants and respondents will not have to engage or communicate directly or be in the same space during the process.
The policy expects all parties to keep information pertaining to the investigation confidential.

items.quote: Victim/Survivors have the right to determine what and how much they choose to disclose about their experience, and to decide whether they would like to make a Report to the University and/or the police.
items.reason: The policy explicitly states that survivors have the right to decide whether to report to the University, the police, or both.

items.quote: Any Student who makes a Disclosure or makes a Report, stating that they were an individual who experienced or witnessed Sexual/Gender-based Violence and Misconduct while under the influence of drugs and/or alcohol will not be cited for violations under any University policies dealing with non-academic misconduct in relation to the use of drugs or alcohol.
items.reason: The policy guarantees that students reporting sexual violence will not be cited for drug or alcohol use policy violations.

items.quote: The University shall endeavour to complete any investigation it undertakes into a Report of Sexual/Gender-based Violence or Misconduct within a timely manner.
items.reason: The policy sets some timelines for specific steps but uses vague language like 'timely manner' for the overall investigation.

items.quote: As part of an investigation process, the University may impose or facilitate interim measures that are determined as necessary and appropriate for the safety of individuals involved and the University community.
items.reason: The policy states that the University may impose or facilitate interim measures, making them discretionary.

items.quote: Off-Campus Activity: refers to University-related activity at any location where curricular activities occur. For example – course projects being done in an off-campus studio environment.
items.reason: The policy generally covers off-campus activities but does not explicitly mention co-op, internships, or work placements.

items.quote: The Complainant has the right to be informed of the outcome of the investigation, but not the details of any Sanctions that may have been applied to the Respondent unless sharing that information is necessary for the protection of the Complainant’s health or safety.
items.reason: The policy limits the complainant's right to know the details of sanctions unless necessary for their health or safety.

items.quote: The Threat Assessment Team will provide an annual report to the Board of Governors on the implementation of this policy at the University in accordance with Section 6 (2) of the Sexual Violence and Misconduct Policy Act.
items.section: Policy Policy review and annual report
items.reason: The policy commits to providing an annual report to the Board of Governors, which is internal rather than public.

items.quote: This Policy will be reviewed every three years.
items.section: Policy Policy review and annual report
items.reason: The policy requires a review every three years instead of every two years.

items.quote: The University will develop a Sexual/Gender-Based Violence and Misconduct Advisory Committee made up of members of the University community, including students.
items.reason: The policy requires student representation on the advisory committee but does not specify a minimum of 30%.

items.quote: The University will make every effort to obtain investigators who are trained in trauma, anti-oppression, anti-racism informed approaches.
items.reason: The policy states the University will make every effort to obtain trained investigators, making it discretionary.

items.quote: The University is committed to providing access to coordinated education and training programs pertaining to preventing and responding to incidents of Sexual/Gender-based Violence and Misconduct to all University community members.
items.reason: The policy commits to providing coordinated education and training programs on preventing and responding to sexual violence.
